title: Shopify E-Commerce Manager / Product Owner (m/w/d)
description: Du kennst Shopify nicht nur aus der täglichen Shop-Pflege, sondern weißt auch, wie man einen Shop von Grund auf aufbaut und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt? Dann werde Teil unseres E-Commerce-Teams bei Holz-Richter! Als Shopify E-Commerce Manager / Product Owner (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung neuer Shopify-Shops für casando. Dabei bekommst du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, deine Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben. Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen E-Commerce, UX und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Shopify-Shops sowohl aus Kundensicht als auch technisch überzeugen. Aufgaben Du übernimmst als Product Owner die Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Shopify-Shops. Du setzt neue Shops möglichst eigenständig auf und entwickelst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter. Du konzipierst und optimierst Shop-Strukturen, Navigation, Landingpages und Customer Journeys mit Blick auf eine gute User Experience und Conversion. Du konfigurierst Shopify, Themes und Apps und entscheidest, welche Lösungen für den jeweiligen Shop sinnvoll sind. Du setzt Anpassungen im Shop eigenständig um und koordinierst bei Bedarf technische Anforderungen. Du kümmerst dich um die Anbindung und das Zusammenspiel von Shopify mit weiteren Systemen, Schnittstellen und Middleware-Lösungen. Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt neue Features, Tests und Verbesserungen eigenverantwortlich um. Du behältst aktuelle Shopify-Entwicklungen, neue Funktionen, Apps und E-Commerce-Trends im Blick und prüfst, welche davon für unsere Shops relevant sind. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Shopify und hast idealerweise bereits selbstständig Shopify-Shops aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt. Du verstehst Shopify nicht nur aus Anwendersicht, sondern bringst auch das notwendige technische Verständnis mit, um viele Anforderungen eigenständig umzusetzen. Du kennst dich mit Shopify Themes, Apps und Schnittstellen aus; Kenntnisse im Bereich Middleware sind von Vorteil. Idealerweise kannst du auch Anpassungen an Shopify-Themes selbst vornehmen. Kenntnisse in Liquid , der Shopify-eigenen Template-Sprache, sowie in HTML, CSS und JavaScript sind ein Plus. Du kannst damit kleinere technische und gestalterische Änderungen möglichst eigenständig umsetzen, ohne für jede Anpassung auf Entwicklungsressourcen angewiesen zu sein. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für E-Commerce, UX und Conversion-Optimierung mit und kannst technische und fachliche Anforderungen miteinander verbinden. Du arbeitest sehr selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für deine Projekte. Du hast Lust, neue Shops von Beginn an mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Entscheidungen aktiv voranzutreiben. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Receivable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world-class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick-start your career in Finance!</p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team.</p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/R ledgers, processing customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner, registering customer payments, dealing with queries effectively and efficiently and maintaining compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return, we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development, including offering you support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/R ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our customer data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of customer data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Efficiently resolve any problems prior to raising and issue of invoice</li> <li>Implement and comply with the Canonical credit control policy</li> <li>Maximise cash collection through the effective collection of debts and maintain records to track debt collection through to conclusion</li> <li>Ensure payments are received in line with contractual terms</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organization skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an enterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Grafikdesigner:in (m/w/d) mit KI-Affinität (Studentische Hilfskraft Remote)
description: Uncoded arbeitet in München an der Schnittstelle von Media und Digital Marketing. Seit 2014 bringen unsere UNCODED Sessions außerdem die Menschen zusammen, die diese Branche prägen, in kleinen Runden, bei denen wir jeden Platz selbst vergeben. Zu unseren Partnern gehören DMEXCO, BMW, Payback und JustWatch. Unser Claim heißt Creating Momentum. Du sollst ihn sichtbar machen. Aufgaben Du gestaltest LinkedIn-Visuals, Präsentationen für Partner und Gespräche mit Entscheider:innen sowie Grafiken für unsere Events, von den UNCODED Sessions bis zum Agentursegment der DMEXCO. Du arbeitest mit unseren zwei Brandkits, Uncoded und NXTGEN Club, und entwickelst sie weiter. Vielleicht kommt bald ein drittes Brandkit dazu. Dann baust du es mit uns auf, vom ersten Moodboard bis zur Vorlage, die das ganze Team nutzt. KI gehört bei dir zum Werkzeugkasten. Du testest Tools, baust Workflows und zeigst uns, wo wir damit schneller oder besser werden, gern auch außerhalb der Grafik. Vieles ist planbar. Manches kommt am Dienstag um 16 Uhr und soll am Abend online sein. Du sagst, was dir auffällt. Wenn eine Vorlage nervt oder ein Format nicht zieht, wollen wir das hören, am besten gleich mit Vorschlag. Bringst du Kommunikationserfahrung mit, schreibst du auch Texte, planst Posts und betreust unsere Kanäle mit. Dann wächst die Stelle von 12–15 auf bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche. Qualifikation Du studierst Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder etwas Vergleichbares. Dein Portfolio zeigt, wie du aus einem Satz ein Bild machst. Darauf schauen wir zuerst. Adobe Creative Cloud und Figma beherrschst du sicher. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Adobe Firefly oder Runway regelmäßig und kannst ehrlich einschätzen, wann ein Bild noch Handarbeit braucht. Dir fällt auf, wenn ein Abstand zwei Pixel daneben liegt. Du arbeitest selbstständig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragt. Ein Plus: Du schreibst gern, auf Deutsch und Englisch, und hast schon einen Social-Media-Kanal betreut. Benefits 12–15 Stunden pro Woche, mit Kommunikationsanteil bis zu 20, flexibel um deine Vorlesungen herum planbar Remote-Arbeit mit optional regelmäßigen Treffen im Münchner Büro Deine Arbeit landet bei Entscheider:innen aus Media und Marketing, auf der DMEXCO, auf LinkedIn und in Partnergesprächen Einblick in ein Netzwerk, das über 25 Jahre in Europas Digital- und Medienbranche gewachsen ist Echter Gestaltungsspielraum, im besten Fall bis zu einem Brandkit mit deiner Handschrift Zeit und Budget für neue KI-Tools Schick uns dein Portfolio und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an der Stelle reizt. Leg außerdem ein Beispiel bei, wie du KI in deiner Arbeit einsetzt, gern mit Vorher und Nachher, weil wir so am besten sehen, wie du denkst. Wenn du auch textest, freuen wir uns über zwei Textproben. Wir sind gespannt auf dich. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Engineer
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like <a href="http://booking.com">Booking.com</a>, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Engineer</strong>, you will work directly inside our most strategic enterprise customers. You will build the software that makes their AI agents work in production, and be measured by the difference it makes for the customer.</p> <p>Our agents are built by business users in Parloa’s platform, AMP. AMP already comes with a broad library of tools and integrations. Your job is the part AMP does not cover yet for a given customer: the last connection into their systems, or a capability the product does not have. Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.</p> <p>The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.</p> <p>On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the hardest engagements.</strong> Run complex programmes with several workstreams. Make the architecture decisions that span Parloa’s platform and several parts of the customer’s organization.</li> <li><strong>Build what AMP does not cover yet.</strong> Systems of record, telephony and contact-center integrations, state management, data readiness, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval. When the answer is unclear, build a prototype quickly and decide whether it is worth pursuing before Parloa invests a full quarter in it.</li> <li><strong>Own production quality and security.</strong> Evals, production readiness, observability and incident playbooks for enterprise-scale traffic. Meet the data handling standards a regulated customer expects, including PII, access control and audit trails. Debug live issues, whether they are technical or caused by model behaviour.</li> <li><strong>Grow the account, and share what belongs in the product.</strong> Drive the second use case, the second business unit, the renewal. Set the delivery standard for other engineers on complex accounts. When something you build would help every customer, flag it. That is how Parloa decides what goes into the core product.</li> <li><strong>Mentor other Product Engineers</strong>, and take part in interviewing and hiring.</li> <li><strong>Use AI well, and set the standard for it.</strong> Decide how AI-assisted work is validated before it reaches a customer’s production traffic.</li> <li><strong>Represent Parloa with senior technical stakeholders.</strong> Work directly with the customer’s principal engineers, architects and security leaders. Be the engineer commercial teams bring in when a prospect asks how the solution would work for them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What this role is not:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Not running the Parloa platform itself.</strong> That is a separate engineering role. The platform is your foundation, and you build what a specific customer needs on top of it.</li> <li><strong>Not agent configuration.</strong> Business users design and configure agents in AMP. You build the integrations and capabilities those agents need.</li> <li><strong>Not a people-management role.</strong> You are an individual contributor and write and review code every week.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>OUR TECH STACK:</strong></h2> <p>Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, frontier LLMs, MCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka/NATS</p> <p>You will not use all of these, and most engagements add something new.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of professional software development</strong>, delivering production systems end to end. Fluent in TypeScript or Python, or able to get there quickly.</li> <li><strong>5+ years leading the design and architecture of large-scale production systems</strong> in customer-facing or enterprise environments, with a focus on reliability, scale and failure modes.</li> <li><strong>Experience leading agentic, spec-driven development in production.</strong> You know when a coding agent’s output is wrong and what checks it needs before it ships.</li> <li><strong>A track record in long-term accounts or fast experiments.</strong> You have owned a strategic enterprise relationship over several years, through an expansion, a renewal or a leadership change. Or you have tested new ideas at the frontier and decided quickly whether they were worth building.</li> <li><strong>Experience as a mentor or tech lead</strong>, helping engineers become independent.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity and with customers.</strong> You work well in complex organizations, build trust quickly with new customer teams, spot risks early and keep your judgment when the stakes are high.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel up to 25%</strong> to customer sites, depending on the engagement.</li> <li>Strong spoken and written communication skills in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or deploying an LLM-powered system used by real users in production</li> <li>Hands-on experience with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering or multi-agent orchestration (few candidates will have all of these)</li> <li>A founder or founding-engineer background</li> <li>Forward-deployed, solutions engineering, product engineering or strategic-partner experience at an enterprise software or AI company</li> <li>Voice or conversational AI, or contact center, telephony or CCaaS integration</li> <li>Experience in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or telecom</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our engineering values:</strong></h3> <p>At Parloa, we hire, promote, and evaluate based on cultural and technical excellence. You’ll thrive here if you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Earn Trust</strong> – act with transparency and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Obsess Over Customers</strong> – always start with the customer problem.</li> <li><strong>Think Big</strong> – set bold goals and pursue them fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Have Integrity</strong> – do the right thing, especially when it’s hard.</li> <li><strong>Disagree & Commit</strong> – debate with candor, align fast, and deliver.</li> <li><strong>Own It</strong> – take full responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.</li> <li><strong>Dive Deep</strong> – master the details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Bias for Action</strong> – move fast, decide quickly, iterate fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Value</strong> – measure success by customer and business impact.</li> <li><strong>Insist on the Highest Standards</strong> – raise the bar continuously.</li> <li><strong>Go the Extra Mile</strong> – make the impossible possible.</li> <li><strong>Hire & Elevate the Best</strong> – raise the bar with every hire.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our recruiting process:</strong></h3> <p>Recruiter Call → Technical Peer Interview → 360° Tech Interview Loop → Bar Raiser</p> <h2><strong>Why Parloa?</strong></h2> <p>We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale—and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments—this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p>Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>

title: Engineering Manager - Data processing Engines
description: <div class="content-intro"><h1><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Workato</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit <a class="link" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></p> <h1><strong>Why join us?</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a </span><strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We are driven by </span><strong>innovation </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">and looking for</span><strong> team players </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">who want to actively build our company. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">But, we also believe in </span><strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment </span><a href="http://www.workato.com/careers"><span style="font-weight: 400;">along with a multitude of benefits</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Business Insider</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></p> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Forbes’ Cloud 100</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world</span></p> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Deloitte Tech Fast 500</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America</span></p> </li> <li> <p><a href="https://qz.com/work/2053446/the-best-companies-for-working-from-home/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Quartz</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers</span></p> </li> </ul></div><h1><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h1> <p>We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a team building core internal infrastructure and developer-facing systems. This role sits at the intersection of project management, engineering leadership, and platform development. The team (Evaluation Engines / Data processing engines) owns foundational components which are embedded into higher level workflow engines and tools. Examples are formula evaluation, data transformation according to predefined mapping, decision models, etc. <br><br>The team is technically strong and highly autonomous. We are looking for an Engineering Manager who can operate effectively in this environment: someone with a strong engineering background who understands complex systems, but does not need to be the deepest technical expert in every area.</p> <p>Your role will be to help experienced engineers work effectively together, create clarity across interconnected initiatives, and improve how the team plans, collaborates, and delivers.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Lead a strong engineering team</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>You will manage and develop experienced engineers with significant ownership of their technical domains. The team is mostly Rust engineers, however they also build libraries for several other programming languages: Go, Ruby, Java, Python, and WASM.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be responsible for regular 1:1s, feedback, performance management, career development, hiring, onboarding, and team health.</p> </li> <li> <p>We expect you to create an environment where engineers can remain highly autonomous while having clear priorities, ownership, and accountability. You will be responsible for team capacity planning and hiring when needed.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Build strong product</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>You will be working closely with Product Managers and department VP to define how the products look, what to build and in which order, what new exciting features we can bring to our customers. As this area is highly technical and speaks Computer Science terms at times, Product Managers will greatly rely on your and your team expertise to make decisions. </p> </li> <li> <p>You will be responsible for working with Quality Engineering and Product Security teams to deliver high-quality products. At the same time in this AI era we expect you to embrace new tools to shift quality and security scans left.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Drive planning and execution</strong></h3> <p>The team owns several interconnected technical areas, often developed across separate repositories and involving dependencies between engineers and projects.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own planning and operational execution across multiple engineering workstreams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Create visibility into priorities, dependencies, timelines, and resource allocation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help the team turn broad technical direction into an executable roadmap.</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify and remove blockers before they significantly impact delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>Balance new development, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define meaningful engineering metrics and use them to identify opportunities for improvement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Keep stakeholders informed about progress, risks, and trade-offs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Plan release and update cycles of the product.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain the product, be responsible for defects triaging and mitigation.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Stay close to technology</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>This is strictly not a purely people-management role. title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d) Medizintechnik
description: Wenzler Medizintechnik fertigt seit 1942 in Frittlingen (Landkreis Tuttlingen) chirurgische Instrumente: Scheren, Klemmen, Pinzetten, bipolare Instrumente und Implantate. Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen mit rund 70 Mitarbeitenden, seit 1995 zertifiziert – heute nach DIN EN ISO 13485 – und werden in dritter Generation von Peter Wenzler geführt. Wir vertreiben über die Medicon eG und fertigen als OEM-Partner für andere Medizintechnik-Hersteller. Unsere Auftragsbücher sind voll. Jetzt geht es darum, unsere Kunden verlässlich zu bedienen und den Vertrieb auszubauen. Dafür schaffen wir eine neue Schlüsselposition: Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für unsere wichtigsten Kunden, die bisher beim Geschäftsführer liegt, und führen die Auftragsabwicklung. Ein Schwerpunkt ist die Liefertreue: Sie sorgen dafür, dass wir Termine zusagen, die wir halten können. Aufgaben Sie betreuen unseren wichtigsten A-Kunden und weitere Schlüsselkunden und bauen diese Beziehungen strategisch aus – mit Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung. Sie führen die Auftragsabwicklung (derzeit eine Person) fachlich und disziplinarisch. Sie sorgen zusammen mit Fertigung und Planung für realistische Liefertermine und deren Einhaltung – auf Basis sauberer Daten und Abläufe in unserem ERP-System. Sie verhandeln Rahmenverträge und Konditionen. Sie planen Forecast und Bedarf gemeinsam mit den Kunden. Sie bauen einen systematischen Verkauf auf: Zielsegmente festlegen, Neukunden gewinnen, bestehende Kunden ausbauen. Sie beobachten Markt und Wettbewerb und entwickeln mit der Geschäftsführung Sortiment und Preisstrategie weiter. Sie sind die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Fertigung und Geschäftsführung und vertreten Wenzler bei Kunden und auf Messen. description: Das erwartet Dich Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO. Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice. This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany. Deine Herausforderungen Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points. Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation. Build a strong leadership layer , clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies. Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies. Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified. Plan the Engineering budget and capacity . Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity. Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance. Make credible commitments with Product . Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments. Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early . Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights. Establish clear data contracts with Data . Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science. Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board. What success looks like In your first year, you will: Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality Dein Profil You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition. You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact. You have led Engineering in regulated, security-critical or high-availability systems. Medical-device or digital-health experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You have built and scaled cloud-SaaS products, ideally in a regulated environment. Health-tech or medical-device experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You also bring broad systems depth across backend services, web and mobile clients, APIs and integrations, data flows, observability, security and operations. Our exact stack is not a hard filter. You currently work hands-on with agentic development workflows and can show how you used, constrained or rejected AI output and made it scale You have shipped products that achieved meaningful customer and business outcomes and bring product judgement and pace, not only engineering rigor. You can challenge Product constructively, make business and technical trade-offs explicit and protect credible commitments under pressure. You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself. You are business-fluent in German and English. A university degree or fixed number of years is not required. We care about demonstrated impact, judgement and responsibility you have personally carried. Warum Caspar Health? A genuine C-level mandate with ownership of Engineering and company technology strategy. The opportunity to combine speed and rigor for digital clinical workflows and make a tangible difference to care. A clear Product-Technology peer model with shared decisions instead of hidden hand-offs. Remote-first within Germany with flexible working hours. Regular in-person leadership in Berlin is part of the role. There is no fixed weekly office quota. You will spend time with clinics, partners and at important meetings when useful. A virtual equity package (VSOP) with meaningful participation in the company's value growth, plus 30 vacation days, a home-office allowance, meal subsidy and a budget for learning, conferences and coaching. High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact! Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus! Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether! title: Junior Product Owner
description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. title: Senior Product Manager, GTM Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our Customers. This role will drive the solution to this challenge.</p> <p>We think of this as the next generation of product marketing, built for a technical product and rebuilt as a part of the Product team. At Cloudflare, PMs are the first sellers, and own their own launches, content, and enablement. This role, like the rest of the team, will be both deep in R&D as well as in the field driving real Customer conversations, feeling firsthand what lands, and turning that into the enablement, materials, and programs the entire field runs on. Your credibility comes from carrying the pitch yourself.</p> <p>You will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line. As a member of the product team, your work in the field shapes the strategy and the narrative. You own how far and how fast that story travels, and how well the field can carry it on its own.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <p><strong>Own the field's ability to win.</strong></p> <p>Build the enablement that lets any account team lead a conversation about agents, bots, attackers, or fraud, end to end. This includes training, playbooks, battlecards, demo environments, proof-of-concept guides, competitive intelligence, and certification. You are measured by how capable you make the entire field, and by how much you free up product experts to build rather than sell.</p> <p><strong>Carry the pitch as a member of the Product team.</strong></p> <p>Join and drive real Customer calls. This keeps your enablement grounded in what actually works. You will stand up and orchestrate a bench of field subject-matter experts who scale this well beyond one person.</p> <p><strong>Amplify our story.</strong></p> <p>Our space is presented through some of the most engaging material in the company, closer to an interactive application than a slide deck. You will extend and evolve that into assets the field can run on its own, and produce new material of the same caliber.</p> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You are deep enough on the technology to earn a room's trust. You can explain, or learn how to explain, how browser automation differs from a headless browser or a credential-stuffing run, where TLS fingerprinting and JavaScript challenges and ML scoring fit into a layered defense, and, most importantly, where security, user experience, and privacy actually trade off against each other.</li> <li>You are deep enough on the technology to earn a room's trust. You may not know our exact stack or space, yet, but you can already reason about things like how browser automation differs from a headless browser, where TLS fingerprinting and JavaScript challenges and ML scoring fit into a layered defense, and where security, user experience, and privacy actually trade off against each other.</li> <li>You have done Product or Product Marketing and wanted more of it. More time with Customers, more technical depth, more ownership of whether the field actually wins. You are looking to drive the conversation first-hand, and not behind the scenes.</li> <li>You have sold or evangelized hard technical products to real Customers, and you want to keep doing it, because you know a message is only true once it survives contact with a skeptical buyer.</li> <li>You can make a complicated idea land with a practitioner and an executive in the same afternoon, in writing, on a call, or on stage, without dumbing it down.</li> <li>You judge yourself by how good the people around you get. You are comfortable enough with AI harnesses or Python, JavaScript, or Bash to stand up a concept of your own.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience selling, marketing, or evangelizing bot management, anti-fraud, or application security.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare's broader platform (WAF, CDN, Zero Trust, Workers) and how Bot Management fits with each.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying Bot Management, Turnstile, or similar in production.</li> <li>A track record of standing up field enablement or subject-matter-expert programs from scratch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and </p> <p>benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <p>Medical/Rx InsuranceDental InsuranceVision InsuranceFlexible Spending AccountsCommuter Spending title: Technical Support Engineer - Developer Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal </p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>Do you love solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our team. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will focus on providing support on our Developer Platform products: Workers, Workers AI, Pages, KV, Stream, R2, D1, DO etc.</p> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You are familiar with Developer Platform products</li> <li>You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have experience solving HTTP, DNS and other networking-related problems</li> <li>You have experience with a common web development language (for example, Javascript)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You understand how the Internet works</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have experience working in a support role where you thrived every time you resolved a ticket</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first  (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and  virtual meetings)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS /  CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript </li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €37,000-51,000. </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Job Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Ideally in Vienna, but anywhere in Spain, Poland or Germany also works</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> English (mandatory); Swedish, Spanish, German, or French is a plus</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in similar roles</li> <li><strong>Salary:</strong> €60,000 – €70,000 gross annually</li> <li><strong>Contract:</strong> Full-time, permanent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🚀 Join fiskaly! Help Us Simplify Tax Compliance for Millions</strong></h2> <p>Millions of people interact with fiskaly every day, even if they never notice it. We're the company behind compliance at the point of sale and e-invoicing — the invisible layer that keeps receipts tamper-proof, fights tax fraud, and helps merchants across Europe ditch paper for good.</p> <p>It's B2B, it's regulatory, and yes, it's complex. But our mission is simple: make tax compliance easy for everyone. If you want to build the infrastructure that quietly powers commerce for millions — you're in the right place.</p> <h2><strong>💼 The Role</strong></h2> <p>European fiscalization and e-invoicing are fragmented, technical and deadline-driven. Every country has its own rules, its own timelines and its own competitive dynamics. Our buyers: POS manufacturers, PMS and ERP vendors, retailers, resellers  are not tax experts, and they do not want to become them. They want to know what a mandate means for them and what to do about it.</p> <p>That translation is your job. You will own positioning and messaging for our products across markets, drive go-to-market for new launches and country expansions, and turn dense regulatory requirements into value propositions that land with a technical partner in Munich and a retail chain in Madrid alike.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role with a wide surface area. You will work closely with Product, Compliance, Demand Gen, Content, Sales and our country teams.</p> <p><strong>🛠️ What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own product positioning and messaging for fiskaly's fiscalization and e-invoicing products (SIGN, RECEIPT, E-INVOICE, SAFE) across multiple European markets</li> <li>Define and continuously sharpen our ICPs and buyer personas, POS manufacturers, retailers, resellers, PMS and ERP vendors, and equip Demand Gen with the segmentation, pain points and messaging they need to convert them</li> <li>Drive go-to-market strategy for new product launches and country/regulation expansions</li> <li>Translate complex regulatory and technical requirements into clear, accurate value propositions</li> <li>Build and maintain sales enablement material, battlecards, one-pagers, demo scripts with Sales and Customer Success</li> <li>Own competitive intelligence and market research across the fragmented European compliance landscape</li> <li>Feed market and customer signal into the product roadmap in partnership with Product Management</li> <li>Keep messaging consistent across DACH, Spain, Italy and our other country teams, with an ear for local nuance</li> <li>Supply the Content team with ideas at scale and shape campaign concepts with Demand Generation</li> <li>Track regulatory calendars (KassenSichV, RKSV, Verifactu, NF525, and what comes next)  these are effectively our market events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>👀 What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in regulated/compliance, fintech or infrastructure software</li> <li>A proven track record positioning a technically complex or regulated product for buyers who are not experts in it</li> <li>Product launches and GTM plans you have owned end to end — not contributed to</li> <li>Strong command of positioning and messaging frameworks</li> <li>Experience managing messaging across multiple countries and languages</li> <li>Hands-on sales enablement content creation</li> <li>Familiarity with competitive intelligence tools and processes</li> <li>Excellent written English and the ability to make complexity feel simple without losing accuracy</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, shifting regulatory timelines and briefs that are not fully formed</li> <li>Cultural sensitivity across DACH, Southern Europe and the Nordics</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong plus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in fiscalization, tax-tech, payments, or POS/retail tech</li> <li>Swedish, German, French, Spanish or Italian in addition to description: Your Role You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes Unser Tech Stack 🚀 · Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium · RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance. Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact. Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal , working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity. Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes. Own capacity planning and growth forecasting , use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security. AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation. Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling , document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team. Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi , deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role. title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description: Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. Deine Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt. Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice . Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst. Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag. Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine. Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken. Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden. Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner. Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Deine Aufgaben Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur. Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen. Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible. Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX. KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz. Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker , IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums. Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten. Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur . Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere. Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung , beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien. Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren. Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
description: Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡ Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land. As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg , you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults. You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future . Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure. Your Benefits • Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form. • Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures. • Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments. • Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs. • Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases. • Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience. Your Responsibilities As a Maintenance Technician , you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg. • Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil. • Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause. • Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system. • Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way. Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician • You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology , or a comparable technical qualification. • You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery. • You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues. • You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal. • You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems. • You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment. • The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage. Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡ Then send us your CV and learn more about the company, the technology, and your future role in a short ten minute introductory call . title: Chief of Staff to the CTO - Engineering
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
