title: Senior Software Engineer, Chaos Engineering
description: <p>Datadog’s Chaos Engineering team builds systems that surface reliability weaknesses before they become outages. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will initially focus on zonal resilience, building automation that helps services safely evacuate and recover from zonal failures, while also contributing to fault injection, incident replay, gameday orchestration, and reliability tooling. You will work across engineering teams to design systems that safely exercise production failure modes and turn findings into verified remediation. You will also help advance the use of AI and automation to identify, test, and close resilience gaps as Datadog’s software and infrastructure evolve.</p> <p>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build zonal-resilience automation that coordinates safe workload evacuations, switchovers, and recovery in partnership with the teams that own affected services.</li> <li>Design and build fault-injection systems for production environments, including infrastructure- and application-level testing, incident replay, and controlled resilience experiments.</li> <li>Develop safeguards such as blast-radius controls, kill switches, validation mechanisms, and rollback paths that keep production experiments contained and reversible.</li> <li>Build agents and automation that help propose failure scenarios, triage experiment results, and connect reliability findings to tracked remediation and verification.</li> <li>Lead gamedays from hypothesis and scenario design through execution, documented findings, remediation tracking, and validation of completed fixes.</li> <li>Design and implement reliable distributed systems, including gRPC services, Kubernetes controllers, and shared platform components, while contributing to technical design and mentoring other engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong distributed systems fundamentals and can reason about consistency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, quorum, retries, and failure recovery.</li> <li>You understand Kubernetes workload lifecycles, including how pods, controllers, scheduling, draining, and eviction interact with resilient system design.</li> <li>You have experience designing, building, or operating production systems where safety, availability, and controlled failure handling are important.</li> <li>You communicate complex technical decisions clearly through design documents, runbooks, postmortems, and cross-functional technical discussions.</li> <li>You are comfortable collaborating across engineering teams to understand unfamiliar systems, identify failure modes, and drive resilience improvements.</li> <li>Experience with reliability engineering, chaos engineering, zonal failover, AI-assisted operational workflows, traffic interception, or large-scale observability systems is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <p>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop deep expertise in distributed systems, production resilience, Kubernetes, and large-scale infrastructure.</li> <li>Work on reliability systems that operate across Datadog’s production environment and influence how engineering teams design for failure.</li> <li>Grow your experience designing safe, automated approaches to fault injection, zonal resilience, and incident reproduction.</li> <li>Explore practical applications of AI and automation to reliability engineering and operational workflows.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, databases, observability, and service teams on complex systems challenges.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical designs, engineering practices, and platform strategy.</li> <li>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</li> </ul> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Partner Marketing Senior Manager
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY Partner Marketing exists to fuel the growth and success of Wellhub's global partner network of gyms, studios and wellness businesses. The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing (France & Benelux) leads Partner Marketing strategy and execution for these markets, as part of Wellhub's regional EU Partner Marketing team. This person will act as the regional Point of Contact (POC) for Partner Marketing in France and Benelux, owning the local Business-to- Partner value proposition, brand positioning, network growth and engagement and, fitness industry events, working closely with Partnerships, local and cross-functional Marketing, Wellbeing Engagement, Product Development and Revenue teams to align strategy and execution. Reporting to the Partner Marketing Director, EU, this role combines strategic ownership of the region with hands-on execution. This role directly impacts the growth and satisfaction of Wellhub's partner network in France and Benelux, contributing to the team's broader goals around partner network growth, partner engagement, and partner satisfaction (PSAT). YOUR IMPACT Market-Specific Value Proposition: Develop and implement the local Business to Partner value proposition across all partner-facing materials and touchpoints for France and Benelux. Brand Awareness & Positioning: Build Wellhub's presence and credibility within the regional fitness industry through relationships with industry associations/alliances, sponsorships, events, media/publications, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Strategic Partner Growth (B2P2C): Lead go-to-market strategy for partner launches, relaunches, and dedicated campaigns and promotions to end users and clients, driving growth with existing partners. Strategic Partner Engagement: Build partner trust through structured engagement initiatives, including fitness industry events, partner conferences and summits. Network Growth Support: Support the Demand Generation team's strategy with local market insights and develop sales enablement materials to drive growth across the partner network. Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Partnerships, User Growth, Corporate communication, Content, Revenue teams local and global level to align initiatives with company-wide strategy. Budget Ownership: Manage the regional Partner Marketing budget for France and Benelux, allocating resources across campaigns, events and other marketing initiatives to drive results and maximize ROI. Data-Driven Marketing: Use performance data and partner insights to inform, prioritize and continuously optimize Partner Marketing initiatives in the region. AI-Driven Productivity: Autonomously identify and apply AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to raise the team's level of automation — streamlining repetitive tasks, accelerating content, reporting and campaign production, and embedding AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day ways of working. Continuously build personal AI fluency and share practices that help the broader team work smarter. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE Native/fluent in French and fluent in English, based in France with deep knowledge of local market and fitness industry culture. Working knowledge of Dutch is a plus, given the scope across Benelux markets. [+8] years of experience in Marketing, ideally with exposure to Partner, Channel, Product or Revenue Marketing in a B2B or B2B2C environment. Proven ability to build value propositions, brand positioning and go-to-market strategies, and to execute them independently as a regional lead. Comfortable managing institutional relationships with industry KOLs, associations and strategic partners. Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. Data-driven approach to marketing decisions, comfortable with CRM and marketing analytics tools. Fluent English is mandatory. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that native/fluent French, prior Marketing experience, and English proficiency are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. HEALTHCARE: Health insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025! This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that's making a real difference? Read more about the award here. Wellhub was named one of the Best Engineering Teams and Top IT Companies to Work For in Portugal! Join a team where technology, purpose, and wellbeing come together. Read more about our award here. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. #LI-HYBRID Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: SMB Success Junior Account Executive
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. We operate in 18 countries worldwide and our platform supports more than 40,000 clients, connecting their employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members across Europe, North America, and South America (2,000+ Wellhubbers and counting!), we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. As we continue to grow, we're extending our presence across Europe, with France among our next key markets! We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Client Success Account Executive II to join our SMB team in Paris ! This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our Paris office. Wellhub is officially expanding into France, and you will join a high-impact team at the forefront of this new venture! As one of the first SMB BDRs in the country, you will play a key role in building our presence from the ground up—generating pipeline, engaging HR leaders, and contributing to both the development of our local sales playbook and our go-to-market approach. This is a rare opportunity to take on real ownership from day one, introduce a global brand to a new market, and help shape our long-term success in France. YOUR IMPACT Reporting to the Country Lead your core mission will be to manage a wide portfolio of growing B2B businesses (typically up to 500 employees) and ensure their long-term satisfaction through the following pillars: High-Velocity Onboarding: Lead the digital launch and setup process for a high volume of new SMB clients, guiding HR leads and business owners through their first 90 days seamlessly. title: Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin Texas, New York, San Francisco</strong></p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Strategy organization operates as a high-velocity engine at the intersection of business, technology, and go-to-market execution, driving enterprise growth, global expansion, market innovation, and strategic execution. Our multi-disciplinary team spans seven core strategic pillars: Network & Infrastructure Strategy, Industry Solutions, Strategic Partnerships, International Expansion, Executive Customer Engagements, Corporate Development & M&A, and the new business model of the Internet. As primary connective tissue across the enterprise, we collaborate closely with Sales, Product & Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Policy to translate corporate vision into measurable, real-world execution.</p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>As a Senior Strategic Partner Manager, you will work directly with Product, Engineering, and executive leadership to identify, build, and launch key partnerships that accelerate our product roadmap and drive platform adoption.</p> <p>The initiatives you own will span strategic co-build integrations, OEM relationships, and complex GTM alliance build-outs. This is a hands-on execution role for a versatile problem-solver—you will own partnerships end-to-end, moving from initial strategic alignment through technical scoping, contract negotiation, integration, and go-to-market launch.</p> <p>You will flex across different technology domains as company priorities shift, diving into technical details, validating integration use cases, and bringing cross-functional teams (Legal, Security, GTM, Finance) together to deliver real outcomes.</p> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships (technology integrations, ecosystem plays, and go-to-market alliances) across Cloudflare's product areas, prioritizing based on where the business needs it most.</li> <li>Partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders to assess technical fit, integration approach, and roadmap alignment for prospective partnerships.</li> <li>Build the business case for each partnership: sizing the opportunity, validating the underlying use case, and making a clear, evidence-based recommendation on whether to pursue it.</li> <li>Lead negotiation and execution end-to-end, from initial scoping through signed agreement and launch.</li> <li>Act as the connective tissue between partner organizations and internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Sales) to ensure both organizations deliver outcomes. </li> <li>Move fluidly across product areas and partner types as priorities shift, ramping up on new technical domains quickly and independently.</li> <li>Demonstrate deep technical fluency. You must be able to independently evaluate technical documentation and engage credibly with engineers, rather than relying on others to translate how a partner’s technology works. </li> </ul> <h2>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product management, strategy or consulting; ideally within a technology or cybersecurity organization. </li> <li>Prior exposure to cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, networking, developer platforms, or AI markets.</li> <li>Technical fluency: able to understand product architecture and engineering trade-offs well enough to independently evaluate partnership and integration opportunities, not just relay them.</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate unstructured, open-ended problems with an attention to detail to close and launch complex deals. </li> <li>A track record of aligning senior stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, GTM and partner organizations around competing priorities, keeping teams accountable, and pushing projects across the finish line. </li> <li>Experience structuring, negotiating, and closing non-standard commercial and technical agreements. </li> <li>Ability to pick up new technical domains quickly and shift focus as business priorities evolve. </li> <li>Executive-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence cross-functionally without formal authority.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Have Skills</h2> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent advanced degree.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>San Francisco Estimated Base salary $161,000 - $221,000.</p> <p>New York Estimated Base salary $153,000 - $210,000.</p> <p>Austin Estimated Base salary $125,000 - $172,000.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division . Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. About the Role Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries. Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout. Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams. Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. About You Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have) Advanced degree ( Master's or PhD ) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics , or a related quantitative field Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management. Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. Engineering and data craft Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets. Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. Soft skills Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions. Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Sales Development Senior Manager to join our Sales team in Berlin! This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office. YOUR IMPACT Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose. Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub. Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward. Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days. Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales. Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs. Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds. Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification. Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You'll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting. Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools. Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager. The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed. You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it's the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE. Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution. You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend. You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact. You should be able to show how you've successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles. You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid, with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office . We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. #LI-HYBRID Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Partner
description: About the Role This is a founding partner opportunity at an AI-native law firm operating in Germany, built on a proprietary agentic platform that automates recurring legal work. You will serve as the firm's primary market-facing rainmaker, bringing an established book of business and helping shape the firm's early growth trajectory. The role sits at the intersection of law, business development, and legal technology, and carries meaningful equity participation. What You'll Do Bring your portable client book onto the firm's AI agent platform and continue serving your existing clients. Act as the primary market-facing presence, opening top-of-funnel opportunities through your PE/VC and mid-market network. Cross-sell commercial and compliance services into your existing client base. Work with the founding team to migrate recurring matters onto the automation platform. Help drive the firm's growth from its current client base toward its next funding milestone. What We're Looking For 12 to 20+ years of experience in legal practice in Germany. German-qualified attorney (Volljurist) admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with a Dr. iur. or LL.M. preferred. Experience at a ranked German law firm or boutique of equivalent standing, at equity or salaried partner level. A personally portable book of business of €1M or more, with clients who follow the attorney rather than the firm brand. Strong network into private equity, venture capital, or mid-market companies that unlocks cross-sell into commercial and compliance work. A diversified client base across multiple sectors, including recurring and automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate/VC, or regulatory matters. Native-level German and professional English. Germany-based and fully work-authorized, with a feasible client migration path within approximately six months and no restrictive non-competes. Genuine conviction in the AI-native law firm model and hands-on experience using AI tools such as large language models or legal AI products in daily practice. Compensation & Benefits The salary range is €200,000 to €300,000 per year , plus meaningful equity in the firm. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location This is a hybrid role based in Berlin, Germany . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Engineer
description: About the Role This is a technical pre-sales role at a Series A AI-powered R&D platform company serving enterprise customers in chemicals, materials science, pharma, and adjacent industries. You will be the primary technical voice in the sales process, partnering with Account Executives to demonstrate platform value, run pilots, and close net new revenue. The role sits at the intersection of deep scientific expertise and customer-facing storytelling. What You'll Do Own the full technical pre-sales cycle, from initial demo through business value case development, technical evaluation, and pilot execution. Architect and build custom demonstrations, workshops, and pilots tailored to each prospect's R&D workflows. Lead demo sessions and technical evaluations, crafting compelling narratives around R&D data management and innovation acceleration. Partner closely with Account Executives and champion stakeholders to drive value-based selling. Write scripts and configure integrations on the platform's integration server to support custom prospect engagements. Mentor and manage new graduate team members who support technical evaluations. Travel 25 to 50% to deliver on-site presentations and workshops with prospects. What We're Looking For MS or PhD in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field with an ML or computational focus; advanced degree strongly preferred. 4 to 7 years of experience in a relevant role, such as technical pre-sales, R&D digitalization, management consulting with a science background, or software engineering. Demonstrated experience leading digitalization or change management initiatives in an industrial or enterprise R&D environment. Proven track record building and demoing technical platforms to enterprise customers. Scripting ability in Python and comfort configuring integrations and automations. Familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows, laboratory informatics systems, or ELN platforms. Strong domain knowledge in chemistry, materials science, or chemical engineering. Excellent communication skills in English; C1 or higher proficiency in German or the relevant local language required for EU-based candidates. Authorized to work in the role's country without visa sponsorship. Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, New York, or London. Compensation & Benefits Salary range: $100,000 to $150,000 USD annually . Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Location This role is fully remote, with primary location in Munich, Bavaria, Germany . Candidates in New York, NY (USA) or London, UK are also considered. Regular travel of 25 to 50% is expected. title: Implementation Manager (Payments/Billing experience preferred) (f/m/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Customer What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects. The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client. 🚀 What you'll own: You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners) You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform. Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have. This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”) Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience Agile delivery experience Experience of product management and customer journeys Solid understanding of technology and associated trends Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude Consulting experience is a plus Fluent English + German Previous experience in payments is nice to have for this position ✨ As our Client Delivery Lead, you’ll be driving success and leading projects directly as a key individual contributor, without direct line management responsibilities. title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (f/m/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies. Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions. Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience. Experience Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level. Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively. Change management using agile methodologies. Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. Other Requirements: Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs. Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages. Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports. Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions. Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration. Fluent German & English is a prerequisite for this role Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧 This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃 You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead . Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site ( FR / EN ) to learn more about our teams and culture. title: Client Delivery Lead (f/m/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Customer What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects. The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client. 🚀 What you'll own: You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners) You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform. Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have. This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. title: Langfuse - Product Engineer, Integrations
description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. What You’ll Do Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience. Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations. Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes. Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem. What We’re Looking For Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it. Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems. Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work? Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach. Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects. Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn. Bonus Points Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries Former founder or early startup experience Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source) No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. Projects You Could Own Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation) Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat) Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. title: (Junior) Creative Director – Design & Brand (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Die Beratungsbranche in Deutschland sieht überall gleich aus. Gleiche Bildwelten, gleiche Stockfotos, gleiche Blautöne, gleiche Sprache. Marke ist in diesem Markt praktisch unbesetzt. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen. Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht. Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt. Die Rolle ist bewusst nach unten offen. Wenn du gerade aus einem starken Gestaltungsstudium oder einer gestalterischen Ausbildung kommst und deine Mappe das visuelle Urteil und die Systemtiefe zeigt, die diese Rolle braucht, bist du hier richtig — du startest dann am unteren Ende der Spanne, arbeitest zunächst an Teilen des Systems und wächst in die volle Verantwortung hinein. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht das Jahr des Abschlusses. Bei Vogel findest du beides: Strukturen, die tragen, und ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Aufbau-Versprechen ohne Boden. Du verantwortest das gesamte visuelle System von Vogel und der weiteren Marken, die daneben entstehen — Print, Digital, Raum, Bewegtbild, Experience. Du setzt selbst um und ziehst Partner dort zu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung es erfordert. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Die Rolle sitzt in München, vor Ort. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in die fachliche Führung des Design- und Brand-Bereichs. Deine Verantwortung Visuelles System und Markenführung Du verantwortest das Designsystem von Vogel — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache, Layout-Prinzipien, Komponenten — und entwickelst es weiter, statt es nur zu verwalten. Du überträgst das System in Content: Social, Publikationen, Whitepaper, Präsentationen, Recruiting-Material. Das System ist erst fertig, wenn andere im Unternehmen damit arbeiten können, ohne dich zu fragen. Du setzt die visuellen Systeme der weiteren Marken auf, die bei Vogel entstehen. Dein Maßstab: Wer drei unserer Touchpoints nebeneinander sieht, erkennt sie ohne Logo als Vogel. Gestaltung über alle Medien Print: Publikationen, Geschäftsausstattung, Mandantenkommunikation, Kampagnenmotive — von der ersten Skizze bis zur Druckfreigabe in deiner Hand. Webdesign: Du gestaltest vogel-beratung.com und die dazugehörigen Seiten weiter, im direkten Austausch mit unserem Webentwickler. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du das Webdesign für alle Standorte und Gesellschaften der Vogel-Gruppe. Eventdesign und räumliche Gestaltung: Standorte, Bühnen, eigene Veranstaltungsformate, Messeauftritte. Du gestaltest, wie Vogel sich anfühlt, wenn man im Raum steht. Experience Design: Du denkst den Weg von Mandanten und Bewerbern als gestaltete Abfolge, nicht als Sammlung einzelner Assets. Kreativ-Steuerung, Partner und Nachwuchs Du steuerst Agenturen, Kreativpartner, Fotografen und Freelancer — Briefing, Auswahl, Qualitätsurteil, Freigabe. Zugeliefert wird Kapazität, die Handschrift bleibt deine. Du steuerst Motion Design von der Konzeption bis zur Abnahme und stellst sicher, dass Bewegtbild aus demselben System kommt wie alles andere. Du leitest unsere Design-Praktikanten und Berufseinsteiger fachlich an, gibst Feedback am Handwerk und baust darauf perspektivisch dein eigenes Team auf. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet hier den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast das visuelle System ausgebaut — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache und Komponenten sind erkennbar weiterentwickelt, nicht nur inventarisiert. Du hast vogel-beratung.com überarbeitet, die neuen Seiten sind live. Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für alle Designthemen im Unternehmen — Anfragen laufen bei dir zusammen, statt bei Externen zu landen. Du lieferst konstanten Output an Assets über alle Kanäle, ohne dass Themen liegen bleiben. Die Marke beginnt, deine Handschrift zu tragen. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Das Designsystem ist in Figma so aufgesetzt, dass Content-, Growth- und Recruiting-Themen ohne dich sauber daraus produzieren. Die täglichen Assets aus dem Beratungsalltag — Präsentationen, Slides, Mandantenunterlagen — entstehen automatisiert per KI auf Basis deines Designsystems. Dass das trägt, hängt an sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren technischen Setup: beides liegt bei dir. Das Designsystem und die Assets aller Sub-Marken der Vogel-Gruppe sind ausgebaut und angewendet — jede Marke hat ein eigenes visuelles Fundament, das erkennbar aus derselben Logik kommt. Dein Partner-Setup steht: ausgewählte Agenturen und Kreativpartner, klare Briefing-Standards, Qualitätsurteil bei dir. Motion Design läuft als eigener Produktionsstrang unter deiner Steuerung. Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast: Vogel ist visuell unverwechselbar — im Markt zuordenbar, ohne dass ein Logo nötig ist. Eine neue Marke setzt du visuell in Wochen auf, nicht in Quartalen — das System trägt das, ohne dass du jedes Asset selbst baust. Du hast mindestens einen Junior-Designer eingestellt, eingearbeitet und auf ein Niveau gebracht, auf dem er eigene Strecken trägt. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Der nächste Schritt ist die fachliche Führung von Design und Brand über alle Marken hinweg (IC-Karriere) — das setzt ein visuelles System voraus, das ohne dich trägt, nicht nur zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Wenn du das Team mit aufbaust und führen willst, öffnet sich zusätzlich die Führungslaufbahn. Wir kennen keinen Automatismus „mehr Erfahrung gleich höhere Stufe". description: Deine Aufgaben Das ist dein Beitrag: In deiner Rolle als Data Engineer/ Database Manager bist du für den Aufbau, die Betreuung und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Dateninfrastrukturen verantwortlich und gestaltest unsere Datenlandschaft aktiv mit. Du verantwortest die Datenakquise und -integration, z. B. aus bestehenden Kundensystemen sowie über definierte Schnittstellen, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die dafür erforderlichen Konzepte. In engem Austausch mit deinem Team, den Fachkolleginnen und Fachkollegen sowie unseren Nutzern konzipierst und entwickelst du neue Schnittstellen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen. Du gestaltest die konzeptionelle und technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Data-Warehouse- und BI-Systemumgebung mit. Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Team Datenqualität, Verfügbarkeit und eine effiziente Verarbeitung unserer Daten sicher und entwickelst bestehende Datenprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du berätst bei analytischen Fragestellungen auf Grundlage der verfügbaren Daten und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Fachbereichen und Kundenteams zusammen. Du wirkst bei der Umsetzung von Anforderungen von der Spezifikation über die Implementierung und das Testing bis zum Rollout mit und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung für deine Themen. Du dokumentierst Datenstrukturen, Schnittstellen und Prozesse nachvollziehbar und unterstützt damit einen nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer im Team. Du evaluierst neue Technologien und Lösungsansätze und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft ein. Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen, Data Warehouses, Schnittstellen und der Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen mit. Du besitzt ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst gleichzeitig fachliche und betriebswirtschaftliche Anforderungen nachvollziehen und in geeignete Datenlösungen übersetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, stimmst dich aber ebenso selbstverständlich mit deinem Team und anderen Fachbereichen ab. Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sichere Englischkenntnisse. Du legst für dich persönlich Wert auf: Ownership – Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst Aufgaben proaktiv voran. Kommunikation – Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln und kommunizierst sicher mit technischen wie auch fachfremden Ansprechpartnern. Motivation – Du begeisterst dich für Daten, Business Intelligence und neue Technologien und hast Freude daran, aus Daten verlässliche Grundlagen für Entscheidungen zu schaffen. Dein Extra Das bieten wir dir: Einen großartigen Teamspirit und spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Zukunftsmarkt und einer Kultur der Verantwortung, Teamworks und Ehrlichkeit. Tatsächliche Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten durch das Einbringen deiner eigenen Ideen und Erfahrungen zur innovativen Weiterentwicklung des DATALOGUE Teams. title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.
