title: Business Development Representative - Marché Français
description: À propos du poste En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout. Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché. Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder. (Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France) Votre mission Prospection et génération de pipeline Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection. Découverte des besoins et qualification Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation. Démonstrations produit Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente. Gestion des objections et closing Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature. Gestion du pipeline Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité. Collaboration Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective. À propos de vous Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet). Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine. Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité de votre pipeline et de vos résultats, au-delà des simples indicateurs d'activité. Vous adoptez une approche structurée de la gestion commerciale : vos prévisions sont fiables et votre suivi est irréprochable. Vous faites preuve de résilience et de régularité dans un environnement exigeant, orienté objectifs et à fort volume d'activité. Une expérience en SaaS, dans la technologie appliquée à l'hôtellerie ou en startup constitue un atout. La maîtrise de HubSpot ou d'un CRM similaire est appréciée. Ce que nous offrons Une rémunération attractive (OTE) composée d'un salaire fixe et de commissions déplafonnées basées sur la performance. Des stock-options avec un calendrier d'acquisition progressif. Une couverture santé complète. Un accès anticipé à votre salaire, sans attendre la fin du mois. Un parcours de carrière structuré, avec des critères d'évolution clairement définis à chaque niveau. Des avantages flexibles permettant d'optimiser vos dépenses liées aux repas, à la garde d'enfants, aux transports et à la formation. L'achat de tout livre professionnel dont vous avez besoin, ainsi qu'un accès à une bibliothèque partagée au sein de l'équipe. Une équipe internationale composée de plus de 35 nationalités, basée dans l'un des principaux hubs technologiques européens. #LI-CL1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Le groupe Lovehoney est le leader mondial du bien-être sexuel. title: People Partner Lead, Germany & Sweden
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Why this role exists You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale. Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully. This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market. Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse Build for German employment structures from day one Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations Phase two: run clinical people strategy live Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it Beyond Germany Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed What you bring 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams A builder's mindset – comfortable European employment landscape (Sweden a significant plus) and know what scales beyond a single market Has built a staffing model that had to scale on an opening cadence, and has localised reward in title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Werkstudent
description: DEINE ROLLE Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein. Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden. Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways. Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools. Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert. Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen. Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen. Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten. Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen. Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle. title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. Meet the team in the office. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! How to Apply Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence? This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. What you'll do Architecture Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. No need to train them. Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms This role is a great fit if… You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Austin, TX</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Washington D.C.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Role summary</strong></span></h1> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Global PubSec Transaction Attorney to support our public sector commercial transactions across the U.S. federal market, U.S. state and local government, and select APAC and EMEA opportunities. title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts. Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country. Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check. Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers. 📈 How you will be measured First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed. 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed. 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped. 🤩 This job is your dream job if: You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2 You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it 🙅 This job is not for you if: You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group What we offer A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea 🧭 Our recruitment process A first call to get to know each other. A deep dive into two deals you closed. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders. A conversation with the founders. Reference checks, with your consent. Offer. We answer after each step. Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. title: Field Value Engineer (m/f/x)
description: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI X energy market opportunities X industrial processes. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions with our Energy OS. Behind it is RIZMO: our autonomous AI agent acts as a digital colleague that builds independently, analyzes continuously, iterates with energy management and uncovers cost-saving potential. As a Field Value Engineer, you bring RIZMO directly to our industrial clients – with both feet on-site. You don't roll out a finished product; you actively build the engine: you train the agent with feedback from the field and make savings visible in euros and megawatt hours. Iteration cycles in hours, not quarters. Tasks Digital Twin: Build live models of entire energy systems – power, gas, steam, water, waste heat, generation and battery storage – including smart-meter and OPC UA integration. Decision Hub: Develop scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses and investment roadmaps together with our clients. Operation Hub: Support cross-site live optimization across day-ahead, intraday and grid services markets. Autonomous Agent: Make RIZMO better – parsing technical documents, researching parameters, running optimizations, finding cost reductions – and feed every insight from the field straight back into the engine. Commercial Ownership: Uncover unstated requirements from operators, plant managers and CFOs, defend business cases up to C-level, and measure your success in euros per unit saved. Requirements Education & Background: Degree in energy engineering, automation engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable STEM qualification. Energy Intelligence: You understand DACH/EU electricity markets (day-ahead, intraday, grid services), physics and thermodynamics, and how production processes interact with energy. Experience with OPC UA, Modbus and OT networks is a plus. AI-Native & Applied AI Engineering: You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, have strong intuition for optimization and numerical models, and can convince even security officers of an agent's reliability. Maker Mindset (High Agency & High Ownership): You iterate fast, treat customer feedback as your highest-priority input, and deliver results instead of waiting for instructions. Language Skills: German at C1 level – most on-site work happens in German. If everything else fits but your German isn't C1 yet: apply anyway. Benefits Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education. Radical Performance Culture: Exceptional results get rewarded directly – with an uncapped OTE bonus of €5k–50k on top of your base salary. Seniority (junior to senior) is decided during the process, not by your title – don't be put off if you see yourself as more senior. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure. Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent). Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club. On-site Culture & Team Spirit: During your first year, you'll work from our office in Münster – that's where you'll get to know our system in depth and join the first deployments hands-on. After that, you'll work close to our clients in one of our industrial clusters (Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux). Not a customer success job, not 9-to-5, not pure algorithm development. Send us the thing you're proudest of – and what you'd most like to build next. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Integrity & Trust Experience
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or London (Hybrid) </strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We're hiring the first embedded Lead Product Designer for Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.</p> <p>Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.</p> <p>Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.</p> <p>This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line</p> <p>This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is.</p> <h3>Who you are</h3> <p>Note: A portfolio is required for this role. Please include a link to work that shows how you think. The interview process will dive in deeper.</p> <ul> <li>A product inventor who works in the medium of design. You've taken genuinely ambiguous, ill-defined problem spaces and defined what the product should be. You can point to work where the concept was yours.</li> <li>You've had to make a complex, high-dimensional system legible to the people who live in it, whether in security, fraud, observability, developer tools, analytics, network operations, finance, or somewhere equally demanding. You don't need a security background, but you need the mind and craft to go deep in one fast.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in your own craft, and you have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You bring independent design conviction. You've originated solutions in spaces with little prior art, and you can clearly articulate why a design is right, or why you're pushing back.</li> <li>Exceptional at the full craft — interaction design, information architecture, and especially data visualization — with enough visual polish to make it real and compelling.</li> <li>Someone who wants to obsess over a domain. You want to go deep, and are excited about pushing boundaries in a complex space.</li> <li>Comfortable with a blank page. As the first design lead, you'll set your own process and build alongside your peers and engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as the first or founding designer on a team or product.</li> <li>Exposure to security, trust & safety, fraud / ad fraud (IVT), or ML-driven products.</li> <li>Comfort prototyping in code, or working fluently with engineers who do.</li> <li>Familiarity with how analysts or operations teams actually work day to day.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Staff Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll turn raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decisions across GitLab's global Support Engineering organization. You'll design dashboards, reports, and data models that help leaders monitor performance, optimize costs, and improve customer outcomes. You'll also promote data innovation by experimenting thoughtfully and working through complex problems.<br><br><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own annual operating plan and capacity planning through data modeling and validation that support workforce and budget decisions.</li> <li>Build and maintain utilization and team-performance scorecards, including automated alerting that surfaces trends in real time.</li> <li>Analyze Support Economics, including cost-per-ticket modeling, self-service savings, and product quality costs.</li> <li>Develop performance indexes and heatmaps across Support Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with go-to-market teams on predictive analytics and churn-prevention models that identify at-risk customers.</li> <li>Define and refine unified customer-schema requirements to create consistent data across systems and a single source of truth.</li> <li>Deliver Monthly Business Review telemetry, executive-ready reporting packages, recurring operational reports, and ad hoc analysis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence analyst, analytics engineer, or in a similar data role, ideally in a software as a service or technology company.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Technical Support, Business Operations, Product Engineering, or similar organizations.</li> <li>Fluency in SQL, including complex multi-table joins, grouping and aggregation, common table expressions, and conditional filters.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Zendesk Explore, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Plan and prioritize work independently in a remote, cross-functional environment across time zones.</li> <li>You may also bring experience with large language model-based tools, artificial intelligence and machine learning workflows, durable data solutions, analytics frameworks, in-depth data analysis, or presenting to senior leaders and executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>Our Support Engineering organization uses data to understand performance, improve customer outcomes, and improve operational practices. You'll partner across Support Engineering, go-to-market teams, Business Operations, and Product Engineering in an all-remote environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. What success looks like Within the first year, you will have: Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Demand Generation Specialist, Hotels (12M FTC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">The Airbnb Hotels organization is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>Airbnb is building the world's largest supply of boutique and independent hotels on its platform. To accelerate that growth, we're hiring a Senior Demand Generation Specialist to own the inbound engine for our Hotels Acquisition team.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, strategic and hands-on role sitting at the intersection of marketing and sales. This is Airbnb's first-ever B2B demand generation role. You'll build the Hotels inbound motion from the ground up across EMEA, as a 12-month pilot that will shape how we scale it globally.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the EMEA inbound strategy and roadmap, prioritising the channels and initiatives that will drive the most hotel go-lives</li> <li>Build and scale multi-channel inbound programs (email, paid, SEO, content, events, partnerships) targeting independent hotels, boutique chains, and hotel groups globally</li> <li>Own the full funnel from lead capture to MQL handoff, including lead scoring, routing, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce, in collaboration with RevOps Teams</li> <li>Design Linkedin campaigns in coordination with regional AE teams to target high-priority segments and geographies</li> <li>Develop outbound-assist sequences (via tools like Mixmax or Outreach) to complement AE prospecting</li> <li>Partner with Global Marketing to build collateral, landing pages, and nurture flows that speak to hotel operator pain points</li> <li>Track, report, and optimize against pipeline contribution metrics: MQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, cost per lead, and influenced revenue</li> <li>Run co-marketing and referral programs with industry partners (channel managers, PMSes, hospitality associations)</li> <li>Build business cases for each campaign, secure budget from stakeholders, and show clear ROI</li> <li>Run a test-and-learn approach: launch quickly, measure, cut what doesn't work and scale what does</li> <li>Use AI and automation to scale campaign creation, content and lead nurture</li> <li>Work with Connectivity, Events, Country Managers and AEs to turn webinars, events and partnerships into measurable pipeline</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">8+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within marketplace, hospitality tech, or SaaS environments</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Proven track record of building inbound programs that generate measurable sales pipeline, including experience building a demand gen function from scratch (startup, scale-up, or new-business environment)</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools (MixMax, Outreach, or similar), and paid channels</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Strong analytical, systems-driven approach; comfortable running campaigns yourself, not just briefing others</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Data-driven: you own your funnel metrics and can connect campaign activity to revenue impact</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate campaigns and create content at scale</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Strong sales alignment instincts; you treat AEs as internal customers</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Comfortable with ambiguity: able to shape your own scope, make the case for investment, and adjust quickly based on results</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Fluent in written and spoken English; additional European languages a plus</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Experience operating globally across multiple regions/languages a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why This Role:</strong></p> <p>Airbnb Hotels is one of the company's highest-priority supply growth initiatives. This role sits at the center of that effort, with direct visibility to senior leadership and the ability to shape how the world's most recognized travel brand expands into professional hospitality. </p> <p>As the first person in this role, you'll help show what B2B demand generation can do for Airbnb Hotels. While this is a 12-month fixed-term contract, a successful pilot could lead to the role continuing beyond the initial term.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">France Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€74.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€92.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Au sein de l'équipe Data Tech & Analytics (DTA), vous interviendrez en véritable support stratégique de la chaîne de valeur média (conseil, trading, tracking). Votre rôle consistera à accompagner les équipes d'experts dans l'optimisation de leur quotidien et de leurs processus. Vous participerez à la création d'outils et de tableaux de bord permettant de valoriser les données de campagnes pour le compte d'acteurs majeurs du e-commerce et des biens de grande consommation. Ce poste vous offrira l'opportunité de découvrir l'écosystème complet de la donnée marketing moderne (cloud, datalake, automatisation, APIs, IA) au sein d'un environnement stimulant et formateur.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Collecter et structurer</strong> les données médias issues de multiples sources afin de les centraliser efficacement au sein de nos bases de données.</li> <li><strong>Traiter et analyser</strong> les volumes de données recueillis en exploitant les environnements cloud et les langages de programmation adaptés pour en extraire des insights pertinents.</li> <li><strong>Concevoir et développer</strong> des tableaux de bord interactifs et des outils de restitution sur mesure pour faciliter la lecture des performances par les équipes d'experts.</li> <li><strong>Optimiser et simplifier</strong> les processus de reporting existants afin de fluidifier la communication et les échanges d'informations entre les différents pôles internes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Bac +4/5 issu(e) d'une école d'ingénieur, d'une formation universitaire en Data ou d'une école de commerce avec une forte spécialisation en traitement de la donnée.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong> Une première expérience n'est pas obligatoire, mais la participation à des projets académiques concrets ou à des hackathons démontrant votre attrait pour la data est un véritable atout.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong> Une forte appétence pour l'écosystème des médias, de la technologie et du marketing digital.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Maîtrise de l'anglais (niveau B2 minimum) indispensable pour interagir avec nos équipes globales et appréhender la documentation technique.</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong> Maîtrise d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, manipulation de données) attendue et connaissance d'outils de data visualisation tels que Power BI serait apprécié.</li> <li><strong>Expertise métier :</strong> Solides bases en SQL requises et notions en Python. La connaissance d'environnements Cloud (AWS, GCP) ou de Data Warehouse est un plus apprécié.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Autonomie :</strong> Capacité à avancer de manière proactive sur vos projets et à prendre des initiatives tout en sachant solliciter votre équipe à bon escient.</li> <li><strong>Curiosité :</strong> Envie d'apprendre en continu, de vous auto-former sur de nouvelles technologies et de chercher des solutions innovantes par vous-même.</li> <li><strong>Rigueur :</strong> Souci du détail et précision dans le traitement et la restitution des données pour garantir la fiabilité des analyses fournies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more informat

title: Director, Channel Sales, South EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running.
