title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.</p> <p>While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €<strong>20k to </strong><strong>€</strong><strong>200k</strong>, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.</p> <p>Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).</p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world</strong>: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li>Your mantra is <strong>#alwaysbeprospecting</strong>: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</li> <li><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work</strong>: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You are a life-long learner</strong>: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers</strong>: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own your destiny:</strong> Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for <strong>80-90% net-new logo acquisition</strong> through self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Get In Early: </strong>The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. </li> <li><strong>Sharpen Your Edge:</strong> Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.</li> <li><strong>Navigate Complexity:</strong> Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>The Winning DNA:</strong> A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Verified Overachievement:</strong> A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We’ll want to see this on your resume. </li> <li><strong>Strategic Grit:</strong> Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.</li> <li><strong>Native French</strong> language</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also offers:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Intellectual Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.</li> <li><strong>A Repeatable Sales Framework:</strong> You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Minded Approach:</strong> You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Process Iteration:</strong> You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our <a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

You will connect market opportunity to field execution: prioritizing segments and accounts, developing repeatable vertical and horizontal plays, strengthening the organization and partner ecosystem, and leading critical customer and alliance initiatives. title: Forward Deployed Engineer H/F
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take Alta Ares’ autonomous air-defense systems from the lab to the field, deploying, integrating, testing, troubleshooting and improving them alongside military operators and customers. You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Product and Operations, across our interceptors, AI guidance, mission-management software, sensors and customer C2 systems. This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical outcomes in real operational environments, often under time pressure and with incomplete information. You should be equally comfortable writing code, debugging systems, analysing telemetry and working directly with operators on a test range. Deployment & Field Operations Prepare and execute customer deployments, live-fire exercises, demonstrations and acceptance trials. Deploy and validate Alta Ares systems, including interceptors, AI guidance and Cyclops mission-management capabilities. Configure systems, networks and interfaces and execute test scenarios against defined success criteria. Work directly with military operators, test teams, integrators and partners. Troubleshoot issues rapidly in the field while maintaining safety and mission objectives. Document test results, incidents, lessons learned and follow-up actions. Systems Integration Integrate Alta Ares systems with sensors, radars, C2 systems, networks and third-party platforms. Develop scripts, configuration tools, APIs and integration components required for deployments. Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions. Execute integration and acceptance testing across software, hardware, communications and system performance. Work closely with Software, AI, Embedded, GNC, Hardware and Product teams. Troubleshooting & Product Improvement Diagnose issues across software, hardware, GNC, sensors, networking, communications, and operator workflows. Use logs, telemetry and test data to identify root causes. Implement safe field workarounds and drive permanent fixes with Engineering. Improve system observability, diagnostics, deployment automation, and reliability. Contribute to hardening systems for GNSS-denied, disconnected, and degraded environments. Turn field experience into concrete product improvements and reusable solutions. Customer & Technical Interface Build trusted relationships with military operators, engineers, integrators, and program stakeholders. Deliver technical briefings, training, and system onboarding in English and French. Communicate system capabilities, limitations, and technical risks clearly. Represent Alta Ares with technical credibility during high-stakes demonstrations and exercises. Create deployment guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures. Candidate Profile 3–7 years in software engineering, systems integration, robotics, embedded systems, DevOps/SRE, solutions engineering or a similar hands-on technical role. Strong Python and Linux skills, with good understanding of networking, APIs, logs and distributed systems. Proven experience deploying and debugging complex hardware/software systems outside a controlled development environment. Ability to understand and troubleshoot systems end-to-end. Experience with UAVs, robotics, autonomous systems, AI/ML, sensors or mission-management systems is highly relevant. Defense, aerospace, C-UAS, ISR or other mission-critical experience is a strong plus. Experience working directly with demanding customers or end users in the field is highly valued. Skills & Qualities Hands-on and technically curious, comfortable moving between code, hardware, networks, telemetry, and field operations. Calm and structured under pressure, with strong operational judgment. High ownership and able to solve ambiguous problems independently. Strong communicator who can translate between operators and engineering teams. Pragmatic, balancing speed, performance, safety and maintainability. Comfortable with frequent travel and flexible hours during deployments and exercises. Fluent English required; professional French strongly preferred. High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive defense technologies. Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
description: Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Role Overview We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. Key Responsibilities Process Development & Industrialization Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. R&D to Production Transfer Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. Process Control & Yield Improvement Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. Equipment & Production Support Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. Process Characterization & Data Analysis Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. Documentation & Communication Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. Strong communication and documentation skills. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. Profile We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. We require proficiency with at least one of Go or Rust, plus exposure to devops tooling like but not limited to Kubernetes, Salt, Kafka or Systemd. Strong Linux / Unix fundamentals will be very helpful. You must have experience working with distributed systems at scale. Experience with cyber security is preferred but not essential.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s culture is busy and multifaceted, and people who succeed here are persistent, have a can-do attitude and a genuine willingness to assume good faith in others. And in common with other big tech companies, we offer medical and dental insurance, mental health support, a tax efficient defined contributions pension plan and life insurance.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description: About Nabla We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! The best of AI at the service of healthcare Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare. Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership. Engineering at Nabla Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale. Your Team At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership. As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product. What you'll do As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product. Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will: Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks. Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care. Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features. Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results. Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting. Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features. To get a sense of the impact you’ll have: Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs. By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes , saving 125 hours of doctor time . Your DNA: The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs. You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture. You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.). You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself. You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline. You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients. You communicate clearly and effectively. Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus. Our Stack Kotlin for backend services LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment Where you'll be based Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers) . Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year. Benefits Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work. Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla: Stock ownership 100% healthcare coverage Meal vouchers Public transportation costs covered at 50% Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! Design at Nabla The Nabla design team works alongside product and engineering to define and deliver high-impact tools that delight clinicians and solve their most pressing pain points. Our team is responsible for discovering, understanding, and framing user needs, crafting seamless end-to-end experiences, iterating on feedback, and maintaining a scalable internal design system. Our product Nabla is a medical AI assistant for medical staff, automating their administrative tasks so that they can focus on their patients, not paperwork. What you'll do Thrive in a rapid-iteration environment, shipping high-quality work quickly, and keeping feedback loops tight between design and engineering Lead the end-to-end design process, from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with business goals Meet users during on-sites to gather feedback and test ideas Partner with product managers to discover and validate opportunities with customers, define requirements, and translate research insights into impactful, well-crafted designs Work with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver cohesive, user-centric products Advocate for user needs throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to strategic decision-making at both the product and executive levels Structure, maintain, and evolve Nabla's internal design system, ensuring consistency and scalability in design practices Your DNA 5+ years of experience designing product experiences at a tech or product-driven company A strong portfolio showcasing user-centric solutions that make complex business logic easy to use for the end user Experience designing for both web and mobile, with a strong understanding of responsive behavior and platform constraints Fluency in Figma Curiosity for new design/protoyping tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Paper, etc.) A doer mindset: you’re ready to jump in, iterate fast, and ship Proven ability to communicate design decisions clearly, from concept to implementation, across multidisciplinary teams Solid visual design skills, with a strong sense of craft: you sweat the details and take pride in shipping polished, refined interfaces Where you’ll be based This position is full-time and based in Paris. or remote france if you’re the profile Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year. Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Business & AI Transformation | Engagement Manager

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution. You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner. What you will do ? Ensure that transformation initiatives deliver tangible business outcomes and sustainable improvements in performance. Lead clients and stakeholders Manage the day-to-day client relationship with senior and C-level stakeholders. Facilitate workshops, decision-making sessions and alignment discussions across business, product and technology teams. Translate between business priorities, operational requirements and technical possibilities. Handle complex queries and challenges with confidence and pragmatism. Navigate complex, political and multi-stakeholder environments successfully. Build trust with clients by combining strategic perspective, delivery discipline and a strong focus on outcomes. Own project delivery Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track. Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability. Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts. Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables. Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team. Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets. Contribute to business development Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders. Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope. Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering. Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions. Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation. Develop people and build the firm Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements. Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities. Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects. Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment. Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier. Requirements What we’re looking for 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm. Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes in environments involving multiple stakeholders. The ability to combine strategic vision, structured problem-solving and operational execution. Experience working across business, product, technology, data or AI topics. A strong understanding of how technology, data and AI can transform business functions, operating models and ways of working. Experience translating business needs into transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives or actionable delivery plans. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, resources and deliverables. Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with confidence operating at senior and C-level. Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly. Demonstrated commercial abilities and an interest in contributing to proposals and business development. An entrepreneurial mindset, with the autonomy, pragmatism and proactivity required to thrive in a fast-growing environment. Fluency in both French and English is required. Benefits Why join Singulier? Work at the intersection of strategy, business transformation, product, technology, data and AI. Lead high-impact engagements with senior executives, investors and ambitious businesses. Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and tangible client outcomes. Work in international taskforces alongside experienced consultants and digital experts. Benefit from significant autonomy, exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a fast-scaling consulting platform. title: Senior Customer Engineer,Indonesia
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Job Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Senior Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer </li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> <li>This role requires frequent travel to Indonesia and work directly with clients communicate in Bahasa Indonesia. Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. description: <h2><strong>Qui sommes-nous ?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. le médico-social et les soins à domicile.</p> <p>Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment.</p> <p>Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried & Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried & Retail.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise.</li> <li>Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care.</li> <li>Manager, title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . About the role As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls , you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution. Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization. Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture. Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com. Key responsibilities Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates. 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..). Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including: Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.). Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations. Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014). Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring). Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations. Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework. Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible. About You Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry. Regulatory Context: Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and ACPR expectations is strongly preferred. Mindset & Working Style: Proactive & Autonomous: A "go-getter" who takes ownership, anticipates control gaps, and brings actionable solutions to the table rather than waiting for direction. Naturally Curious: A drive to understand end-to-end business operations, data flows, and complex payment mechanics. Rigorous & Analytical: Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to leverage data analytics to evaluate controls, transactions and processes objectively. Languages: Fluency in French and English is required. Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clear findings and influence decision-making across lines of defence. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
